name: com.scratchdb/scratchdb
title: ScratchDB
description: Checked pricing, free plans, GitHub stars and npm downloads for developer and AI tools.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find developer and AI tools on ScratchDB by need or name (for example "postgres with auth", "email API", "Clerk"). Tools matching every word come first, then tools matching some of them; ties go to live GitHub stars and npm downloads. Misspelled words are corrected when no tool matches. Filter by category, open source or free plan, or sort by price. Each result links to its ScratchDB page and carries a short summary of the tool's facts.

query.description: What the tool should do, or its name. Leave out to list a category by usage.

category.description: Category name or slug: Databases, Auth, Hosting, UI Libraries, AI Coding Tools, AI Models, AI Platforms & APIs, LLM Frameworks, No-Code, Payments, Email, ORM. Setting it gives the most precise results.

free_plan.description: Only tools with a free plan or free to use.

sort.description: "price": free-to-use tools first, then by paid_from_usd_month, cheapest first. Tools without a plain monthly price go in a separate unpriced list. Included volumes differ between plans.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Everything ScratchDB knows about one tool: pricing and free plan (checked against the official pricing page on the facts_checked date; null means not checked yet), license, live GitHub stars and 30-day gain, npm downloads, latest release, repo activity, who it is a good fit for and not, main features, alternatives and comparisons, and the sources used.

slug.description: Tool slug or name, for example "supabase" or "Supabase".

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Compare 2 to 4 tools on pricing, free plan, license, GitHub stars and npm downloads. When ScratchDB has a written comparison for a pair, it adds the short answer, what each is best for and the main differences.

slugs.description: Tool slugs or names, for example ["vercel", "netlify"].

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Other live tools in the same category as the given tool, most used first (by GitHub stars and npm downloads). Tools from the same maker are left out. Filter to open source only.

slug.description: Tool slug or name, for example "firebase".

tools.name: trending
tools.description: Tools gaining the most GitHub stars over the last 7 or 30 days, from ScratchDB's daily snapshots of the public GitHub API. Optionally within one category.

tools.name: new_launches
tools.description: What is new on ScratchDB: tools launched by their makers in a given week (weeks start on Monday; without a week, the latest week with launches), with each tool's pricing, licence and stars, plus tools our editors added (in that week when a week is given, otherwise the 10 most recent).

week.description: Any date in the week, YYYY-MM-DD.
